name: Exp_ATR_Normalize_Histogram
summary: This EA uses ATR (Average True Range) normalized into a histogram format to identify momentum shifts and volatility-based trading opportunities. It generates buy/sell signals when the normalized ATR histogram crosses threshold levels, indicating significant changes in market volatility and directional momentum. The EA opens positions based on these histogram crossovers and manages trades with ATR-derived stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA使用ATR（平均真实波幅）归一化为直方图格式来识别动量转换和基于波动率的交易机会。当归一化ATR直方图穿越阈值水平时，生成买入/卖出信号，表明市场波动率和方向性动量的显著变化。EA基于这些直方图交叉开仓，并使用ATR衍生的止损和止盈水平管理交易。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于将ATR指标归一化处理并转换为直方图形式，以便更直观地观察市场波动率的变化和动量转换。入场条件为当归一化ATR直方图从负值区域上穿零轴或阈值时做多，从正值区域下穿零轴或阈值时做空，这代表波动率扩张和方向性动量增强。出场条件包括固定止损止盈或基于ATR倍数的动态止损止盈，以及直方图反向穿越信号平仓。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或基于账户余额百分比的仓位计算方式。资金管理方面依赖ATR来衡量市场波动并据此调整止损距离，但缺乏对账户整体风险的全面控制机制，如最大回撤限制或动态仓位缩减策略。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on normalizing the ATR indicator and converting it into a histogram format to more intuitively observe changes in market volatility and momentum shifts. Entry conditions trigger a buy when the normalized ATR histogram crosses above the zero line or threshold from negative territory, and a sell when it crosses below from positive territory, representing volatility expansion and strengthening directional momentum. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit or ATR-multiple-based dynamic stops, as well as closing positions on histogram reversal crossover signals. Position sizing typically employs fixed lot sizes or account balance percentage-based calculations. Money management relies on ATR to measure market volatility and adjust stop loss distances accordingly, but lacks comprehensive account-level risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits or dynamic position reduction strategies.

pros: 使用ATR归一化直方图能够有效过滤市场噪音，识别真实动量转换信号
基于ATR的动态止损止盈能够根据市场波动率自适应调整，比固定点数止损更合理
直方图形式的可视化表示使得信号判断更加直观和客观，减少主观干扰
pros_en: Using ATR normalized histogram effectively filters market noise and identifies genuine momentum shift signals
ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit adapts to market volatility, more reasonable than fixed pip stops
Histogram visual representation makes signal judgment more intuitive and objective, reducing subjective bias
cons: 归一化ATR直方图在低波动率横盘市场中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致反复亏损
缺乏对交易时段和市场条件的过滤，可能在流动性较差的时段产生不利交易
没有包含资金管理的高级功能如最大回撤保护、连续亏损后自动缩减仓位等风险控制机制
cons_en: Normalized ATR histogram tends to generate frequent false signals in low-volatility ranging markets leading to repeated losses
Lacks trading session and market condition filters, may produce unfavorable trades during low-liquidity periods
Does not include advanced money management features like maximum drawdown protection or automatic position reduction after consecutive losses
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器，如ADX或波动率阈值，在横盘市场中抑制交易信号以减少虚假信号
加入最大回撤保护和连续亏损后的自适应仓位缩减机制，提升资金管理安全性
improvements_en: Add market state filters such as ADX or volatility thresholds to suppress trading signals in ranging markets and reduce false signals
Incorporate maximum drawdown protection and adaptive position reduction after consecutive losses to improve money management safety

risk_points: 归一化ATR直方图在低波动横盘市场中可能产生大量虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏最大回撤保护和自适应仓位管理，在极端行情下可能遭受重大损失
risk_points_en: Normalized ATR histogram may generate numerous false signals in low-volatility ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Lacks maximum drawdown protection and adaptive position management, may suffer significant losses in extreme market conditions
